accepted_answers.name: functools.lru_cache (Python standard library)
accepted_answers.why: C-implemented, thread-safe, zero-dependency LRU with size bound and cache_info introspection.

accepted_answers.name: cachetools
accepted_answers.why: Accepted when more policies are needed (TTL, LFU, RR) beyond a plain LRU.

notes: Strong consensus. Hand-rolled dict caches leak memory (no eviction) and are rarely thread-safe.
problem: Caching expensive function results in Python with a hand-rolled dict cache.
